Needs Bin state apex-oop-atlas (tools/turbo-compat.ts), set by the chain, never by queue.ts, as atlas-oop-1126 does (2026-11-27: night-plan.ts does steps (1)-(3) from the queue keys binState and binStage, sha256 read back; apex-oop-atlas = state apex (our fork build of FORK da4b80eb from game-copy/rewind-bridge-1119/install: asi + bridge pair + ts3wrap.exe with the 64-bit plugin host #158, sha256 values in its fork.json) plus the staged atlas-oop.dll; the PR158 asi and ts3wrap.exe are no longer used (no stock or PR158 fallback: the state refuses while the fork install is missing or stale); fork oop client and protocol 5 plugin inferred compatible, not seen in a log): (1) copy game-copy/ApexRadiance.asi.pr158 and game-copy/ts3wrap.exe.pr158 (Apex PR #158, plugin host; builds.json apex.pr158 / ts3wrap.pr158) and game-copy/atlas-fardesc/atlas-oop.dll (x64, protocol 5, plugin version 4, sha256 26126d18a631a5c5e57a2db054a5b93060d2ff5d01a51eae4f877fb8e31ded04) into game-copy/apex-oop-test; (2) `node tools/builds.ts check game-copy/apex-oop-test/ApexRadiance.asi --expect apex.pr158`, the same with ts3wrap.exe --expect ts3wrap.pr158, and sha256sum of atlas-oop.dll; stop on any difference; (3) `node tools/turbo-compat.ts state <dir> apex-oop-atlas`, this queue, then `collect <dir> apex-oop-atlas`. The restart host and the plugin list come from apexToml (put back after the job). Scratch save Repro-FarDesc-1126 and the folder Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\ts3native\atlas\fd\ are removed by hand after the run. All 64 class (b) pick sites are covered (test mode: hooks 36/36 = 3 by-id Find swaps + 29 site swaps, pick sites 64/64); Enable=1 arms when every swap goes in (still default 0) and is not tested by this queue.
